description: Fork of exp696 (1.4247 @ 100.7M). Single change: qk_tph 256 -> 512 (NAP=4 sweet-spot kept). qk_lut per-layer 3.15M -> 6.29M (2x), total +18.87M -> ~119.5M. Completes qk shape grid: same total params as exp701 (NAP=6,tph=128) but at the NAP=4 sweet spot, just with more tables. Tests if NAP=4 quality scales with table count or is already saturated at exp696. Refs: exp696=1.4247 @ 100.7M (baseline), exp701 (NAP=6,tph=128, 119.5M)=1.4291 final.
